item.text: The existing general edit writes `leadId` directly, so I’m separating that write at the repository boundary as well as adding the new service checks.

p = 'src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]/settings/project-settings-form.tsx'
s = open(p).read().replace('visibility, status, lead and colour.', 'visibility, status and colour.').replace('import type { OrgId, UserId }', 'import type { OrgId }').replace('const { orgId, project, members, onSubmit } = props;', 'const { orgId, project, onSubmit } = props;').replace('      const leadId = String(formData.get(\"leadId\") ?? \"\");\\n', '').replace('        leadId: leadId.length === 0 ? null : (leadId as UserId),\\n', '')
start = s.index('        <div className=\"space-y-1\">\\n          <label htmlFor=\"leadId\"')
end = s.index('        <div className=\"space-y-1\">\\n          <label htmlFor=\"color\"', start)
s = s[:start] + s[end:]
open(p, 'w').write(s)
PY
npx tsc --noEmit"
